visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a split-screen montage featuring a man with short brown hair in a green polo shirt eating a crusty, golden-brown baguette. The bread is sliced open, revealing a bright reddish-orange filling. In the upper-right quadrant, his facial expression is one of intense focus and enjoyment as he takes a large bite. Yellow captions appear at the bottom. (2) The man is then seen walking on a sunny outdoor sidewalk, holding a large brown paper bakery bag above his head. He wears a gray cross-body bag over his green shirt. The street background shows lush green trees and modern urban architecture. (3) Inside a brightly lit bakery, the camera pans across shelves filled with various breads, including melon pans and croissants. The man sits at a small table inside the shop, holding a piece of the baguette, demonstrating its texture to the camera with his hands. (4) A staff member's hands, wearing white gloves and blue plastic arm covers, are shown using a long knife to slice a baguette on a white cutting board. The man then holds up a clear plastic cup filled with iced coffee. (5) In a different, more dimly lit indoor setting, the man holds a truffle salt bread in a plastic wrapper, taking a large bite and looking surprised by the flavor. The video concludes with a close-up of a half-eaten bread roll and a text graphic providing address details.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a high-energy male narration in Mandarin, delivered with rapid-fire speed and a joyful tone. A cheerful acoustic guitar-driven BGM plays in the background, maintaining a steady, upbeat major key. Loud, crisp, and high-frequency crunching sound effects are synchronized with the visual eating actions, dominating the mid-frequency spectrum. (2) As the narrator describes walking outside, a subtle transition occurs; the acoustic texture expands to include a faint outdoor hum with distant bird chirps. The speaker's pitch variability increases as he expresses excitement, featuring several sharp rising intonations. The BGM maintains its presence with a clear percussive beat. (3) Upon entering the bakery, the audio signature shifts to an indoor room tone with a soft spectral bandwidth. A distinctive metallic 'shink' sound of a knife slicing through thick bread crust triggers a new phase, followed immediately by more emphasized crunching SFX. (4) The narration reaches a peak intensity as the speaker shouts in high arousal, exhibiting a bright spectral centroid. The BGM swells slightly to match his energy before a final digital notification chime sounds, coinciding with the appearance of the end-screen graphics and store contact information.
